ideas.idea: Explain the integrations claim on home page by listing supported integrations or linking an integrations page
ideas.why: The home page line 'Integrates with all the tools you already use.' is vague, and naming real integrations gives readers and machines concrete facts.

ideas.idea: Add pricing details or a contact/demo link on the pricing page
ideas.why: The pricing page only says 'Talk to us for a quote' and gives no plan facts, so adding them would help people and machines understand the offer.

ideas.idea: Expand feature descriptions or add dedicated feature pages
ideas.why: The features page is a single thin sentence, so more specific content would help readers and machines understand the product.

ideas.idea: Add release dates and authors to changelog entries
ideas.why: Changelog entries render as bare strings with no dates, so dates are a real clarity gain when the data exists.
The sitemap has no lastmod, but this advice fits nearly any site and has modest effect.

ideas.idea: Add explicit charset, viewport and social preview metadata to root head
ideas.why: This is standard boilerplate advice for any site and is not specific to this repository's problems.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite JSON-LD for site identity
ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is a stated acceptable choice, so recommending it as a fix goes against that.
